standard_prerequisites.name: Pullback of a sheaf along a morphism and its stalks
standard_prerequisites.statement: For a morphism f : Y -> X of algebraic spaces the unit F -> f_*f^{-1}F, whose stalk at a geometric point y over x is F_x via the canonical isomorphism (Properties of Spaces, declared as a tagged source pointer).
standard_prerequisites.use: It computes the composite at a geometric point in the injectivity step (source lines 381-387).

standard_prerequisites.name: Etale locality of the equalizer statement
standard_prerequisites.statement: The statement that the image is the equalizer is local on X for the etale topology, so one may assume Y is an affine scheme.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the reduction at source lines 390-391.

standard_prerequisites.name: Chow's lemma for algebraic spaces
standard_prerequisites.statement: Every algebraic space Y admits a surjective proper morphism Z -> Y with Z a scheme (Cohomology of Spaces, declared as a tagged source pointer).
standard_prerequisites.use: It produces the scheme Z at source lines 394-395.

standard_prerequisites.name: Surjective proper morphisms of schemes are ph coverings, and the scheme case
standard_prerequisites.statement: A surjective proper morphism of schemes is a ph covering (Topologies), and for schemes the equalizer statement is known (Etale Cohomology, declared as tagged source pointers).
standard_prerequisites.use: They transfer the result from Z to Y at source lines 397-402.

core_obligations: Injectivity: at a geometric point y over x the composite F_x -> (f_*f^{-1}F)_x -> (f^{-1}F)_y is the identity, whence the unit is injective (source lines 376-387).
Reduce the equalizer statement to Y an affine scheme by etale locality (source lines 390-391).
Choose Z -> Y surjective proper with Z a scheme by Chow's lemma and observe that it suffices to prove the statement for Z -> X (source lines 394-396).
Conclude from the scheme case, using that Z -> X is a ph covering, and record the author's remark that the statement is in some sense equivalent to it (source lines 397-402).

proof_roadmap.step: Prove injectivity of the unit by a stalk computation at a geometric point.
Reduce to Y an affine scheme by etale locality.
Chow's lemma gives Z -> Y surjective proper with Z a scheme; the case Z -> X implies the case Y -> X.
Z -> X is a ph covering of schemes, so the scheme case (declared pointer) finishes the proof.

difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-surjective-proper at source lines 365-373: for a surjective proper f : Y -> X of algebraic spaces over S and a sheaf F on X_etale, the map F -> f_*f^{-1}F is injective with image the equalizer of the two projections induced by Y x_X Y. The author's proof at source lines 375-403 first proves injectivity by evaluating at a geometric point of X and using the stalk of the pullback (one cross-chapter result declared as a tagged pointer), then reduces the equalizer statement to the case where Y is an affine scheme by etale locality, chooses a surjective proper Z -> Y with Z a scheme by Chow's lemma (a second pointer), observes that Z -> X is then a ph covering (a third pointer) and concludes from the scheme case (a fourth pointer), of which the author notes the statement is in some sense equivalent. The counted argument is thus a complete reduction whose cited ingredients are all outside the chapter and are declared as tagged source pointers rather than used as missing steps.
